craft_notes: Sthāyin: the turn — authority announced. Sanskrit-first: adhunā kept now (the discourse's pivot); asyaiva āgamasya kept this-very-tradition (ekatva emphasis); prāmāṇyam kept authority (not 'validity' — weight). Rows: 1 ('of this very tradition's authority' closes — prāmāṇya end-weight). Close: 'of this very tradition's authority.' Rejected: 'validity' — killed: prāmāṇya is authority (legal weight); 'is proclaimed' — killed: ucyate pass kept stated.

reads_against.argmap: What is announced now? → The discourse turns from rite to prāmāṇya: āgama's authority takes the floor.
c1_essence: The authority of this very tradition is announced as the discourse's next subject.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of authority established (wonder settling into doctrinal calm)
